scope: Read-only inspection of packed JavaScript in OpenAI-signed macOS software. No account, remote host, pairing, or runtime dispatch was used.

behavior.clipboard: A local thread uses the bare URI. A non-local thread uses the actual hostId supplied by the app, serialized by URLSearchParams, with an optional access-mode field when provided.
behavior.nativeParser: The parser retains hostId for a threads UUID. The main dispatcher adds it to the internal thread URL.
behavior.copiedLinkReader: The renderer checks the threads UUID and exact path, allows at most one hostId and no other query field or fragment, and validates the decoded host ID.
behavior.unverified: No connected remote host, sign-in, or remote thread opening was tested.
